title: Diffusion Fiction Lab: Chinese Chapter-Heading Couplets
description:
Phase 1 of a study of whether diffusion language models (LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-v0-Instruct-7B) write Chinese chapter-heading couplets (回目) better than an autoregressive model of similar size (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), on new couplets from the novel 《火候》 and on familiar classical ones. This release completes phase 1: code, data, every generation, the scored results, the author's blind grades, the write-up (results/results.md) and a post hoc theory note with its analyses (results/theory.md, explore/).

The grading dry run, which was never part of the study, is excluded. Original project materials are MIT-licensed. Wikisource-derived material retains attribution and its documented source terms, including CC BY-SA 4.0 for contributions. See NOTICE.md.
